# Data

**SYNTHETIC DATA** — `demo_campaigns.csv` is generated by `scripts/generate_demo_data.py` (seed 42). It is not the official hackathon dataset.

It has 20 campaigns (C01–C20) over 180 days (2026-01-01 → 2026-06-29). C18–C20 are tiny campaigns with about 1–3 conversions a day.

| incident_type | campaign | window | effect | is_incident |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tracking_break` | C05 | 2026-02-20 → 02-26 | conversions & revenue × 0.05, clicks unchanged | 1 |
| `budget_exhausted` | C12 | 2026-03-19 → 03-31 | impressions, clicks, spend, conversions, revenue × 0.02 | 1 |
| `bid_strategy_change` | C03 | effect from 2026-04-15 to end; **label** 04-15 → 04-21 | CPC × 1.6, clicks × 0.9, conversions × 0.95 | 1 |
| `spend_spike` | C09 | 2026-05-08 → 05-09 | CPC × 2.5 (spend up, clicks unchanged) | 1 |
| `seasonal_shift` | all | 2026-05-20 → 06-02 | all volume metrics × 1.4, ratios unchanged | 0 (not an incident) |

Put the official CSV in `data/official/`. The API test suite picks it up automatically.
